summary: Backend review for PerksLocks: 11/13 pytest tests PASSED, 1 SKIPPED (Sweden/NL has no Over 1.5 because main O/U emit was absent for that fixture), 1 FAILED (Soccer Over 1.5 Poisson synthesis under-emits: 2 picks vs spec's ≥10). PASS: (1) Conflicting picks dedupe — 0 events with >1 game-outcome pick on Soccer slate (114 picks scanned); Sweden @ Netherlands has exactly 1 game-outcome pick ('Netherlands Win or Draw', lock 95.9). (2) Over 1.5 quality is correct — both synthesized picks carry model_line=true and model_source='poisson_from_main_total'; Bohemians @ Shelbourne lock_score=90.1, Grêmio Novorizontino @ Ponte Preta=86.7. (3) MLB /api/mlb/live shape — response is {games:{...}, as_of:...}; under games both plain 'Cincinnati Reds @ New York Yankees' (with commence_time '2026-06-19T22:35:00Z' ISO UTC) and dated 'Cincinnati Reds @ New York Yankees|2026-06-19' keys exist (42 game keys total). (4) Player Intel: refresh returns {seeded_new:0, learned_updates:83, total_profiles:186}; profile lookups for Mbappe→'Kylian Mbappé' (high-xG attacker), Mahomes→'Patrick Mahomes' (dual-threat QB), Sinner→'Jannik Sinner' (archetype='aggressive server' — see note), LeBron James→'LeBron James' (two-way wing) all pass; /list?sport=Soccer&limit=10 returns 10 players with archetype/team/position fields populated. Response is wrapped: profile endpoint returns {profile:{...}} and list returns {sport,count,players}. (5) /api/auto-elite?sport=MLB returns 200 {sport:'MLB',count:0,players:[]} — no 500. (6) Full slate (129 picks): 0 events with duplicate game-outcome picks. FAIL: Test 2 — only 2 'Total Goals Over 1.5' picks across the whole Soccer slate (114 picks, ~25 events). Root cause: synthesis is gated inside the totals block in sports_engine.py:711 — it only fires when the bulk Odds API returned a main Total Goals O/U line for that event; only 3 events on today's slate had a main Total Goals O/U (Bohemians, Grêmio Novorizontino, and one more), so only 2 Over 1.5 synthesizable. Sweden @ Netherlands has NO Total Goals market at all → no synthesis possible from current data path. Either (a) main-line totals are being filtered out upstream, or (b) synthesis needs a fallback when only ML/spreads are present (e.g. fit Poisson from xG/team-strength priors rather than market O/U).

Synthesis at sports_engine.py:711 requires a main Total Goals line; today only 3 events had one. Either widen upstream totals emission or add a model-prior fallback that doesn't depend on the bulk O/U line.

rca_of_issue: Over 1.5 Poisson synthesis only fires inside the soccer totals processing block in /app/backend/sports_engine.py:711-785. The block is entered only when the soccer event's bulk Odds API payload contains a `totals` market with a main O/U line in [1.0, 3.5]. On today's slate (114 soccer picks, ~25 events), only 3 events had an upstream Total Goals line — so synthesis produced just 2 Over 1.5 picks (one main line was already 1.5, so no synthesis needed there). Reproduction: GET /api/picks/today?sport=Soccer&line_type=both → grep market='Total Goals Over 1.5' → count=2. Sweden @ Netherlands has 13 picks total but none are Total Goals (only Win-or-Draw + player props). Mitigation: extend synthesis to use a model prior (team xG / form factors already used elsewhere in sports_engine for Soccer) when the upstream totals market is missing, so every soccer event yields an Over 1.5 pick when a credible lambda can be derived from non-market signals.
